Hi team — reviewed the attachments. Summary and asks below (see inline notes in CloudLogix_DPA_redline.docx).

Summary: CloudLogix is generally acceptable as a processing vendor for short-term telemetry, but there are three items we need addressed before legal approval:

1) Flow-down language — the Order Form redline removes our right to require subprocessors to accept identical flow-down obligations. We need explicit language: "Subprocessor shall be bound by data protection obligations at least as protective as those set forth in the MSA and DPA, including audit rights and breach notification timelines." Please ask AeroFleet to insert that as a non-negotiable flow-down clause.

2) Audit / Evidence — CloudLogix provided SS A E18_Summary (attached) but not full SOC/SSAE report. We require either: a) full SOC2 Type II (preferred) or b) access to a completed recent third-party pen-test report plus evidence of remediation for critical/high findings. If CloudLogix cannot provide a SOC2 by signing, require a contractual right to receive it within 90 days of start.

3) Liability and Indemnities — the Order Form redline caps liability for CloudLogix at $100k which is below our acceptable risk threshold for processors handling customer telemetry linked to PHI/PII (even if scope says no PII). Ask AeroFleet to remove or increase the cap, or include carveouts for security incidents and indemnity in favor of AeroFleet/Redwood where CloudLogix caused a breach.

Operational asks for Aditya / Sales:
- Confirm whether AeroFleet can accept a 2-week delay if CloudLogix needs time to produce SOC2/pen-test materials.
- Determine whether the contract path will be AeroFleet DocuSign (preferred) or Redwood needs to counter and route.

Cameron: please provide the CloudLogix SOC2 timeline and the portal link for shared evidence (if available). Also confirm the exact scope (are they seeing any customer email addresses or account IDs?).

I attached suggested redline language snippets (also inserted into the docx). Let me know and we can produce the final DPA/Order Form markups for execution.

Lauren Bishop
